articles.title: Announcing the Google Gen AI SDK for Kotlin 10 Idiomatic multiplatform access to Gemini
articles.summary: Integrating modern generative AI capabilities into Kotlin applications shouldn't require juggling raw HTTP clients or bridging disparate Java libraries.
articles.detail: The Google Gen AI SDK for Kotlin provides idiomatic multi-platform access to Gemini, allowing developers to easily integrate AI capabilities into their applications.

articles.title: Google named a Leader in 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services
articles.summary: Gartner has named Google a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Cloud Platform Services, positioned furthest for Completeness of Vision.
articles.detail: This recognition reflects Google's longstanding dedication to helping customers build and scale their most demanding workloads reliably and securely on Google Cloud.

articles.title: Run Spark 31% faster and optimize compute costs with Amazon S3 Express One Zone on Amazon EMR
articles.summary: Accelerate your containerized workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service using Azure Container Registry with Artifact streaming.
articles.detail: Artifact streaming allows you to scale your workloads without having to fully wait for images to be pulled, reducing the time it takes to deploy and run applications.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
articles.summary: Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions, including US Gov Virginia and China North 3.
articles.detail: This expansion enables customers to manage IP addresses more effectively across multiple regions and environments.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Reader Endpoint for Azure Database for MySQL
articles.summary: The public preview of reader endpoint support simplifies connection management when using multiple replicas in Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server.
articles.detail: A reader endpoint enables automatic load balancing of read-only connections, improving the performance and scalability of applications.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Artifact Streaming on AKS
articles.summary: Artifact streaming accelerates containerized workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service using Azure Container Registry.
articles.detail: Artifact streaming allows you to scale your workloads without having to fully wait for images to be pulled, reducing the time it takes to deploy and run applications.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes
articles.summary: Azure Firewall's auto-learn SNAT routes is now generally available, automatically learning registered and private destination prefixes periodically.
articles.detail: This feature simplifies SNAT management and preserves original source IPs in Azure Firewall configurations.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Auxiliary Logs Plan in Azure Government and China regions
articles.summary: The Auxiliary table plan in Azure Monitor Logs is now generally available in the sovereign clouds: Azure Government and China.
articles.detail: This cost-effective option for ingesting and retaining high-volume, verbose logs enables compliance and auditing use cases.

articles.title: ZGateway: Learnings from Putting a Proxy in Front of ZippyDB
articles.summary: Meta introduces ZGateway, a proxy for unifying traffic through ZippyDB, its most widely-used key-value store.
articles.detail: ZGateway enables admission control, load balancing, cross-region resilience, and richer operations on top of ZippyDB.

articles.title: Sparks Fly: NVIDIA Accelerates Local AI at IFA 2026
articles.summary: NVIDIA announces faster inference and new tools for setting up and running local AI agents on its hardware.
articles.detail: New compact NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs are coming in October to give AI enthusiasts, developers, and creators more options for local AI development.

articles.title: Migrate VMware Storage to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP using AWS Transform
articles.summary: Enterprise storage underpins every critical workload in a VMware environment.
articles.detail: AWS Transform helps migrate VMware storage to Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, delivering automatic failover, instant snapshots, and inline deduplication.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Purchase order mapping available in Microsoft Marketplace
articles.summary: Align Microsoft Marketplace purchases to your business's accounting needs.
articles.detail: Purchase order mapping helps allocate your Microsoft invoice, including Marketplace purchases, making it easier to reconcile your organization's cloud and AI spend.

articles.title: Broadcom Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
articles.summary: Broadcom reported record third-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue, operating income and free cash flow.
articles.detail: The company's results were driven by sharply higher demand for artificial intelligence capabilities.

articles.title: The AI Infrastructure Stock Nobody Talks About Enough
articles.summary: Cisco is posting hyperscaler AI order numbers that would make pure-play networking rivals jealous.
articles.detail: Cisco's valuation still reflects a company selling switches and routers, but its AI infrastructure business is growing rapidly.
